# Hi, I'm Jonathan

I build **intelligent systems** connecting the physical and digital worlds together — AI platforms, decision intelligence, and digital twins for mission-critical infrastructure.

Engineer building data and AI systems for the physical world.

## Purpose of this Site

This site is a constant work in progress—part portfolio, part notebook, and part personal knowledge base. I use it to share my work, research, ideas, and anything else that captures my interest, while also reflecting on what I am learning along the way. In that sense, it is inspired by Leonardo da Vinci’s approach to his notebooks: an evolving collection of observations, questions, experiments, and ideas that was never truly finished.

:::

## What I'm Doing Now

Working at **Peraton** as a systems engineer, combining data engineering, software engineering, and data architecture to develop scalable data and AI infrastructure. My focus is building the foundation for advanced capabilities such as **digital twins, agentic AI, machine learning, and large-scale analytics**.

## Passion Projects

### AeroFlux

**[AeroFlux](projects/aero-flux/index.qmd)** is an R&D sandbox for cyber-physical intelligence — working out how networks of interdependent agents moving through shared physical space can perceive distributed state, anticipate how disturbances propagate, and act before the decision window closes. U.S. domestic flight delay is the proving ground: measurable, tractable, and richly instrumented enough to build against for real. The architecture is the point — the same loop is what drone fleets, autonomous ground systems, and distributed sensor networks need, where the state is physical, the coupling is tighter, and the consequences are kinetic rather than schedule-based.
